contextBudget.note: A fresh install mounts every row whose component default is on. defaultOnTools is exact: one more default-on tool fails the suite until the count is raised here with its measurement, or the component ships off. Measured 2026-11-22 after the knowledge-plane docs tools and the L5X l5x_ prefix rename landed: l5x 55 + ftview 52 + mwi 24 + optix 32 (31 vendored engine tools registered in packages/optix/lib/index.js, including the preview-gated optix_preview, optix_screenshot, optix_ocr and optix_render_check, plus optix_netlogic which the reader registers separately) + engineering-resources 2 + migration 8 = 173 (plc5 15 and slc 10 ship off; viewers has no tools). defaultOnSchemaCharacters is the measured 130049 characters of the default-on generated definitions (L5X 53718 + FactoryTalk View 45544 + MotionWorks IEC 18488 + Engineering resources 1474 + Migration 10825) plus a 4% allowance for wording changes; the DXF/DWG drawing viewer is a face with no tools and is excluded, and the Optix tools are not generated from source and are bounded by the tool count instead.

skillPolicy.note: A skill body is injected into the request when the skill is invoked, so the budget is a context-cost ceiling. Depth belongs in docs/ and is linked, not embedded. The tested pair cost is the sum of two product bodies: l5x 10265 + ftview 7975 = 18240 characters (about 4.6k tokens), so a workflow skill must stay near 3k to keep a three-skill load near 6k.

maturityPolicy.note: stable: the tool set and its result contract are settled, so a change is additive and a breaking one carries its own release note. beta: works and is documented, but the tool set or a result may still change between releases without notice. experimental: ships off by default or behind a flag and may be reshaped or removed. since is the first release whose cordis.patch.yml carried this component's row id, not the last change to it. A stable component must name the document that records its last real verification; a beta or experimental one must say what is not proved yet.
maturityPolicy.since: The first release tag whose patch carried the row id, e.g. v0.86.0.
